title: TriMas Packaging to exhibit at Beautyworld Dubai 2026
summary: Explore high-performance, sustainable dispensing and closure packaging solutions for fragrance, beauty and personal care at Beautyworld Dubai, October 6-8
body_markdown:
## Experience innovative packaging solutions for fragrance, beauty and personal care


TriMas Packaging is pleased to once again participate in[Beautyworld Dubai 2026](https://beautyworld-dubai.ae.messefrankfurt.com/dubai/en.html) , celebrating the event’s 30th edition as one of the region’s premier gatherings for the beauty industry. Throughout the three-day event, attendees can explore our broad portfolio of packaging solutions designed to help fragrance, beauty and personal care brands **enhance performance, advance sustainability goals and strengthen brand differentiation** .


### Event Details


- **Date** : October 6–8, 2026
- **Location** : Dubai World Trade Centre, Dubai, UAE
- **Booth** : SR-G27


Featured at the booth will be our **fragrance pumps and luxury closures** , engineered to deliver reliable performance and elevated consumer experiences. Available in a wide range of colors, finishes and decorative options, these solutions enable brands to create distinctive packaging that reflects their unique identity. The portfolio includes **crimp-on, snap-on and screw-on formats, as well as the new CV11 travel-size format** for on-the-go, sampling and discovery applications.


TriMas Packaging will also showcase its **Singolo™ portfolio** , a fully recyclable, all-plastic dispensing platform for beauty and personal care applications. The range includes 2cc and 4cc lotion pumps, foaming pumps, treatment pumps and fine mist sprayers, combining dispensing performance with flexibility in design and customization.


Attendees can experience our dispensing solutions firsthand through interactive product demonstrations, offering a closer look at product performance, functionality and customization possibilities.


### Visit us at **Booth SR-G27 to discover how TriMas Packaging is helping beauty and personal care brands create premium packaging solutions that engage consumers and bring their brand vision to life.**
